rule: Spec 055 §6.1-§6.2: the bytes the Python writer produces, which TypeScript reproduces exactly. json: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii) of json.loads(input), UTF-8, or refused (a lone surrogate has no UTF-8 form); ids: encode_opaque_id, run_pseudonym and pseudonym_v2 of the JSON-escaped value (UTF-8 surrogatepass); records: FWSPOOL1 | u32be(header length) | header (sort_keys, literal UTF-8) | bodies | sha256; batches: FWSPOOLB | u32be(count) | (u64be(length) | frame)* | sha256; sealed: FWSPENC1 | key id | nonce | AES-256-GCM(plain, aad = FWSPENC1 | key id | basename), key id = kid- + 8 hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, 'fabric-spool/v1/kid'); ledger: the >8sII header and an FWLSLOT1 slot (u32be length | ASCII JSON {owner, records} | sha256, zero padded); registrations: the 4096-byte FWEPOCH1 file (little-endian fields, sha256 of bytes 0-255 at 4064). The spool key and nonce are fixed test values.
